name: DGX Spark LingSante-3.1-air-VL Atlas (SparkLing 0.1.0)

weights.description: Which checkpoint the engine serves: spark is Enntity's NVFP4 quantization of the original BF16 with NVFP4 prefill and decode and Ling-3.2-air's MTP predictor borrowed as the drafter; strict is inclusionAI's original BF16 as published, at checkpoint precision without drafting.

spark.description: Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 (MIT, about 76 GB): quantized directly from inclusionAI's original BF16, the routed expert matrices packed as NVFP4 in groups of 16, the non-expert weights kept as published. SparkLing's Spark defaults: NVFP4 prefill and NVFP4 attention decode, and DRAFTER=ling-mtp, Ling-3.2-air's MTP predictor from four files of primitive-ai/Ling-3.2-air-NVFP4A16 (about 5.6 GB), joined to the checkpoint in a view directory that hard-links its files.

strict.description: inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL (MIT, about 250 GB): the original BF16 checkpoint as published, checkpoint precision, no drafting. Atlas pages its expert matrices from disk to fit one Spark.

summary: inclusionAI's LingSante-3.1-air-VL (the medical vision-language Ling) on one DGX Spark with SparkLing 0.1.0's Atlas build: text, image and video input, tools, reasoning, prefix caching and its native 131,072-token window. --weights spark (default) serves Enntity's NVFP4 quantization with NVFP4 prefill and decode and Ling-3.2-air's borrowed MTP drafter; --weights strict serves the original BF16. Three modes: default (8 requests), saver (1 request of 8,192 tokens) and max (16 requests). Additive only: no default model, no aliases.
description: This recipe installs SparkLing 0.1.0 at the immutable product revision recorded in backends/atlas-sparkling/pins-0.1.0.json. The Atlas engine image is built from Enntity/SparkLing by install/build.sh and published to GHCR; LLooM commits no engine source. Setup acquires the selected checkpoint at its pinned revision (Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 for spark, with four sha256-checked files of primitive-ai/Ling-3.2-air-NVFP4A16 that carry Ling-3.2-air's MTP predictor; inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL for strict), pulls the image by its manifest digest and verifies it, then runs SparkLing's own install/check_files.py and, for spark, install/prepare_sante_draft.py, fetched at the pinned revision, digest-checked and run inside the image with no network. They check every inference file against its pinned size and hash and, for spark, build the view directory the engine serves: the checkpoint's files hard-linked, the predictor added, and the result checked against install/checkpoint-sante-draft.json. Setup remembers the weights it installed with.

provenance.source: SparkLing 0.1.0: Enntity/SparkLing 46afd596505480a370392f2dc88ea36644e519b7 (tag v0.1.0, install tree a66a1e6464f475f033d7bfc8b2b3a6ac75c65bf4), engine Enntity/atlas ling/3.2-air @ dc0035de58878ff8b339cb8e0692b48f45398d1f (AGPL-3.0-only, recorded in the image's /opt/atlas/source-manifest.json). Image ghcr.io/enntity/atlas-sparkling:a66a1e6464f4 (also :0.1.0), addressed by its GHCR manifest digest. Profiles default.json (0.80 GPU memory utilization, 8 sequences), saver.json (0.70, 1, 8192) and max.json (0.88, 16), all with BF16 KV, prefix caching and ffmpeg video decoding; the engine caps LingSante at its native 131072 tokens. Checkpoints Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 revision 2702935791ac4f04b2b103c748a19de89f6df940 (MIT; quantized from source revision 1f398c937d6069994a156689636832c47d8c09be) and inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL revision 1f398c937d6069994a156689636832c47d8c09be (MIT), checked against SparkLing's install/checkpoint-sante-nvfp4.json and install/checkpoint-sante-air-vl.json; borrowed drafter from primitive-ai/Ling-3.2-air-NVFP4A16 revision 3a78e58506316b5b9b7d06037910c3f4abdd291f (MIT; config.json, model.safetensors.index.json, experts-layer42.safetensors, rest-001.safetensors).

hardware.testedMachine: One DGX Spark with 128 GB unified memory
notes: This version pins the SparkLing 0.1.0 image ghcr.io/enntity/atlas-sparkling:a66a1e6464f4 (also :0.1.0; install tree a66a1e6464f4, Atlas dc0035de5), addressed by its digest. Its build ran 8,827 engine tests with 0 failures.

SparkLing 0.1.0 on one GB10, 2026-11-25, Spark weights, default profile (131,072 tokens) and default drafting, nothing else on the GPU (Enntity/SparkLing results/2026-11-25/README.md): single stream 53.9 tok/s (mean of eight greedy prompts, 256 tokens, thinking off), drafted text equal to plain decode on 8 of 8; aggregate 48.0 / 62.3 / 79.0 / 105.2 tok/s at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 clients, median time to first token 1.06 s at 8; 30 of 30 arithmetic word problems with thinking on; 10 of 10 single-tool calls; a red-to-blue clip, a counting clip as GIF and MP4, a 90 s 720p clip, an invoice and a grid all read correctly.

Spark drafts with Ling-3.2-air's MTP predictor, borrowed at setup (SPARKLING_DRAFTER=ling-mtp), one token per step for one active request, plainly from two; LingSante verifies each proposal with its own weights. In the same file's decision runs, drafted text matched plain decode 8 of 8 at 53.7 tok/s against 43.1 plain (NVFP4 prefill and attention decode).
LingSante declares 131,072 tokens natively; the engine caps every profile there (its publisher's 256K configuration uses YaRN and is not served). The KV pool is shared across requests.
A medical model: its answers are not medical advice and it is not a medical device.

Profiles (SparkLing install/profiles, all BF16 KV and prefix caching, 2,048-token prefill chunks or 8,192 with NVFP4 prefill, ffmpeg video decoding on): default 8 requests at 0.80 GPU memory utilization, saver 1 request of 8,192 tokens at 0.70, max 16 requests at 0.88. Requests the KV pool cannot hold yet wait rather than fail. Strict shares one KV pool between requests (ATLAS_KV_MAX_BLOCKS in each profile).

Strict serves the original checkpoint for reference. It does not fit in memory, so Atlas pages experts from the checkpoint on disk and it decodes far slower than Spark; Strict was not part of the 0.1.0 release measurement.

Peak host memory was not measured per mode. LLooM reserves an estimate: saver 92 GB, default 104 GB, max 114 GB. The container is capped at 114 GiB because a GB10 that runs out of shared memory hangs instead of killing a process. In the default and max modes little else should use this Spark's GPU memory.

The engine serves 127.0.0.1:8897 (fixed by the image) with host networking, so only one SparkLing model runs at a time; its memory reservation keeps LLooM from starting the other beside it. Text, image and video input: OpenAI image_url parts and video_url parts (animated GIF decoded in-process, MP4 and WebM through the image's ffmpeg).

Licenses: the Atlas engine and SparkLing's install tools run from the image and are AGPL-3.0-only (not included in LLooM). inclusionAI/LingSante-3.1-air-VL, Enntity/LingSante-3.1-air-VL-NVFP4 and primitive-ai/Ling-3.2-air-NVFP4A16 are MIT.
